notes: Intent 96. Scopes: description triggering (1-5) and behavior (6-10: lock-first spine, ask-mode-once, terminal report-only, mode->arm mapping, boarding matrix). The lock-first and gate behaviors are also proven by Ruby tests (test/bridge_guided_test.rb, test/lock_gate_test.rb, test/lock_gate_hook_test.rb).

evals.expected_output: Activates plastic-intent-starting (board a session onto the named intent).
Activates plastic-intent-starting (the --intent form boards a specific intent).
Activates plastic-intent-starting when an intent is in context to be worked.
Does NOT activate plastic-intent-starting; bare 'continue' is plastic-continuing (no specific intent named).

evals.prompt: create a new intent for the uploader retry policy
evals.expected_output: Does NOT activate plastic-intent-starting; activates plastic-creating-intent.

evals.prompt: Active intent X exists at the Why station. Start work on it (guided).
evals.expected_output: Takes the lock FIRST via Bridge.arm_guided (auto stays false) before any mutating work, confirms savepoint, then boards at Why and continues brainstorming toward spec.md.

assertions.check: lock acquired before any mutating write; SKILL.md 'Lock FIRST' section precedes station work
Bridge.arm_guided stamps the lock with auto=false (test/bridge_guided_test.rb green); lock-gate denies a no-lock write to the active intent dir (test/lock_gate_hook_test.rb green)

evals.prompt: Start work on an active intent without saying auto or guided.
evals.expected_output: Asks 'auto or guided?' exactly once after reporting the station; never re-asks at later stations.

assertions.check: SKILL.md asks the mode exactly once and states 'never re-asked at a later station'

evals.prompt: Start work on an intent that is Done in INDEX.
evals.expected_output: Reports only: no lock, no resume, no reopen. Summarizes the outcome and asks what is next.

assertions.check: terminal intent -> report only, no arm call

evals.expected_output: guided -> Bridge.arm_guided; auto -> Bridge.arm_auto then hand off to plastic-auto (auto branch's only remaining job is the handoff).

assertions.check: SKILL.md maps guided->arm_guided and auto->arm_auto+handoff to plastic-auto

evals.prompt: Start an intent whose savepoint last line is 'How  checklist.md created'.
evals.expected_output: Boards at Exec (verify plan + checklist real), per references/boarding-matrix.md, and continues delivery/ticks the checklist.

assertions.check: boarding matrix lands 'How checklist.md created' / 'Exec started' at Exec
